checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Three separate image files were returned.
All three are landscape, about 640x384 (5:3). None is square, 4:5 or 9:16.
Same red car in all three, redrawn slightly.

must.item: Complete car visible in every version
must.why: Whole car is visible in each one.
The car looks nearly the same. The image 3 version is a wider, zoomed-out scene. It has minor redraw differences such as the badge and the plate.

must.item: Padding is blurred source photo and no text
must.why: There is no blurred padding. There is no added text either, but the framing was not done as asked.

faults.what: None of the outputs has the requested aspect ratio. All are about 640x384 landscape, so the core request is not met.
Two outputs are near copies of the original, so the three sizes are not meaningfully different.
The AI redrew the scene. The street layout and trees shifted a little, and there are small detail changes.

summary: All three outputs are landscape images of about 5:3, so none is square, 4:5 or 9:16, and the sizing request failed even though the car is whole and no text was added.
